title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a mellow, jam‑heavy show highlighted by a juicy Slipknot / Eyes sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers great sound quality with a clear, balanced mix that lets the band's relaxed improvisations shine. Reviewers especially praised the hidden Slipknot/Eyes jam as a standout moment, and overall describe the set as a nice collection of jams worth enjoying.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers who left detailed comments gave 5‑star ratings, noting excellent sound quality and strong jam performances; the limited number of reviews (3) yields moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great sound quality reported; crisp mix with no noted dropouts or muffiness, allowing the Slipknot/Eyes jam to come through juicy and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, flowing set of jams that builds nicely into the highlighted Slipknot/Eyes segment.
